items.title: Needle: We Distilled Gemini Tool Calling into a 26M Model
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, Henry here from Cactus. We open-sourced Needle, a 26M parameter function-calling (tool use) model. It runs at 6000 tok/s prefill and 1200 tok/s decode on consumer devices. We were always frustrated by the little effort made towards building agentic models that run on budget phones, so we conducted investigations that led to an observation: agentic experiences are built upon tool calling, and massive models are overkill for it. Tool calling is fundamentally retrieval-and-assembly (match query to tool name, extract argument values, emit JSON), not reasoning. Cross-attention is the right primitive for this, and FFN parameters are wasted at this scale. Simple Attention Networks: the entire model is just attention and gating, no MLPs anywhere. Needle is an experimental run for single-sh

items.raw_excerpt: 2025 年到 2026 年，如果要问生成式 AI 领域最值得关注的研究方向，流匹配（Flow Matching） 是一个无法绕开的答案。 从去年起，这个名字开始频繁出现在顶会论文里、被工业界反复讨论、被拿来和统治了图像生成领域长达五年的扩散模型正面比较。 所谓流匹配，本质上是用常微分方程路径（ODE path）替代扩散模型的随机微分方程路径，让数据从噪声到图像的转变不再依赖数百步迭代，从而在理论上实现更高效的生成。但从理论可行到工程落地，中间隔着无数技术细节——训练目标怎么设计、架构怎么选、速度和质量如何兼顾，每一步都是坑。 何恺明团队正是在这个节点上，密集地交出了一份多角度的答卷。 AI科技评论总结了何恺明团队近期在CVPR大会上发表上的论文：  2025 年 5 月，他们提出了均值流（MeanFlow），首次将"均值速度场"引入生成建模；同年年底，BiFlow 在归一化流框架上实现了 700 倍加速，将 FID 推到 2.39；几乎同一时间，Improved MeanFlow（iMF）则以三个系统性修复将单步 FID 降至 1.72，首次在无蒸馏条件下超越所有蒸馏方法。 生成模型之外，团队在视觉推理（VARC，CVPR 2026）和自监督学习（Pixo，CVPR 2026）上也同时出击，共同勾勒出一个清晰的战略意图：扩散模型并不是图像生成的终点，流匹配这条路，值得全力押注。 这五篇论文之间没有直接的方法传承，方向各有侧重，但贯穿其中的核心问题始终如一： 在每一个被默认的技术选择背后，到底藏着多少被低估的优化空间？ 让"去噪"模型真正做一次去噪 理解 JiT 的工作，需要从扩散模型一个被忽视已久的痛点说起。 当前的扩散模型在训练时，网络学习预测的目标是噪声 ε 或速度 v，而非干净图像 x。 这个细节在大多数论文里被一笔

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2025 年到 2026 年，如果要问生成式 AI 领域最值得关注的研究方向，流匹配（Flow Matching） 是一个无法绕开的答案。 从去年起，这个名字开始频繁出现在顶会论文里、被工业界反复讨论、被拿来和统治了图像生成领域长达五年的扩散模型正面比较。 所谓流匹配，本质上是用常微分方程路径（ODE path）替代扩散模型的随机微分方程路径，让数据从噪声到图像的转变不再依赖数百步迭代，从而在理论上实现更高效的生成。但从理论可行到工程落地，中间隔着无数技术细节——训练目标怎么设计、架构怎么选、速度和质量如何兼顾，每一步都是坑。 何恺明团队正是在这个节点上，密集地交出了一份多角度的答卷。 AI科技评论总结了何恺明团队近期在CVPR大会上发表上的论文：  2025 年 5 月，他们提出了均值流（MeanFlow），首次将"均值速度场"引入生成建模；同年年底，BiFlow 在归一化流框架上实现了 700 倍加速，将 FID 推到 2.39；几乎同一时间，Improved MeanFlow（iMF）则以三个系统性修复将单步 FID 降至 1.72，首次在无蒸馏条件下超越所有蒸馏方法。 生成模型之外，团队在视觉推理（VARC，CVPR 2026）和自监督学习（Pixo，CVPR 2026）上也同时出击，共同勾勒出一个清晰的战略意图：扩散模型并不是图像生成的终点，流匹配这条路，值得全力押注。 这五篇论文之间没有直接的方法传承，方向各有侧重，但贯穿其中的核心问题始终如一： 在每一个被默认的技术选择背后，到底藏着多少被低估的优化空间？ 让"去噪"模型真正做一次去噪 理解 JiT 的工作，需要从扩散模型一个被忽视已久的痛点说起。 当前的扩散模型在训练时，网络学习预测的目标是噪声 ε 或速度 v，而非干净图像 x。 这个细节在大多数论文里被一笔
excerpt_i18n.en: From 2025 to 2026, if asked which research direction in generative AI deserves the most attention, Flow Matching is an unavoidable answer. Since last year, this term has frequently appeared in top conference papers, been repeatedly discussed in the industry, and directly compared with diffusion models that dominated image generation for five years. Flow Matching essentially replaces the stochastic differential equation path of diffusion models with an ordinary differential equation (ODE) path, enabling the transition from noise to images without relying on hundreds of iterative steps, thus theoretically achieving more efficient generation. However, bridging theory and engineering involves countless technical details—how to design the training objective, choose the architecture, and balance speed and quality, each step fraught with challenges. It is at this juncture that He Kaiming’s team has delivered a multi-faceted set of results. AI Tech Review summarizes the papers published by He Kaiming’s team at recent CVPR conferences: In May 2025, they proposed MeanFlow, introducing the "mean velocity field" to generative modeling for the first time; later that year, BiFlow achieved a 700x acceleration within the normalizing flow framework, pushing FID to 2.39; around the same time, Improved MeanFlow (iMF) reduced single-step FID to 1.72 through three systematic fixes, marking the first time without distillation.
excerpt_i18n.es: De 2025 a 2026, si hablamos de las direcciones de investigación más destacadas en el campo de la IA generativa, el Flow Matching es una respuesta inevitable. Desde el año pasado, este nombre ha comenzado a aparecer con frecuencia en artículos de conferencias de primer nivel, ha sido debatido repetidamente en la industria y se ha comparado directamente con los modelos de difusión que han dominado el campo de la generación de imágenes durante cinco años. El llamado Flow Matching, en esencia, reemplaza la ruta estocástica de ecuaciones diferenciales de los modelos de difusión con una ruta de ecuaciones diferenciales ordinarias (ODE path), permitiendo que la transformación de datos de ruido a imagen ya no dependa de cientos de iteraciones, logrando así una generación teóricamente más eficiente. Sin embargo, desde la viabilidad teórica hasta la implementación práctica...

excerpt_i18n.en: The storage industry has entered a historic upward cycle over the past year. According to a report released by TrendForce in February this year, traditional DRAM contract prices in the first quarter of 2026 rose by 90% to 95% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025; NAND Flash contract prices in the first quarter of 2026 increased by 55% to 60% from the previous quarter. However, starting in late March, the market suddenly shifted, with panic selling in the DRAM spot market causing spot prices of DDR4 and DDR5 memory modules to drop significantly. Data shows that the price of mainstream 32GB DDR5 kits fell from around 2,999 yuan in mid-March to approximately 2,200 yuan, a monthly decline of nearly 27%. The downturn in the spot market has left many industry professionals and investors puzzled: Is the real supply-demand balance tight or not? Given the massive demand for AI computing power, why has traditional memory experienced a spot market crash? Is the bullish logic for storage stocks still valid? To address these questions, Leiphone invited two guests from the front lines of the storage industry chain to analyze the truth behind this storage cycle and its future direction from multiple perspectives, including channels, customers, and system manufacturers. Guo Zhaobin: Vice President of Sugon Beijing and senior technical expert, with 15 years of experience in storage system architecture and R&D. He led the development of the distributed storage system ParaStor and the all-flash storage system FlashNexus, both of which have topped global performance rankings multiple times, with deep implementation experience in key scenarios such as AI inference and high-frequency financial trading. Wang Wenhao: Changhong Jia
excerpt_i18n.es: El sector del almacenamiento experimentó el año pasado un ciclo alcista histórico. Según un informe de TrendForce publicado en febrero, los precios contractuales de la DRAM tradicional en el primer trimestre de 2026 aumentaron entre un 90% y un 95% respecto al cuarto trimestre de 2025; los precios contractuales de NAND Flash en el primer trimestre de 2026 subieron entre un 55% y un 60% en comparación con el trimestre anterior. Sin embargo, a partir de finales de marzo, el mercado cambió repentinamente, con ventas masivas por pánico en el mercado spot de DRAM. Los precios spot de los módulos de memoria DDR4 y DDR5 cayeron considerablemente. Según datos, el precio de un kit de 32 GB de DDR5 pasó de unos 2999 yuanes a mediados de marzo a cerca de 2200 yuanes.

On one hand, JD.com, eager to make strides in AI, was recruiting talent for its research institute, particularly from Alibaba, SenseTime, and Baidu. On the other hand, Tencent's AI Lab team, led by Yu Dong, was seeking a trusted top-tier speech expert. At the time, Liu Qiangdong, who had long intended to personally manage JD's research institute, was desperate for talent. He even met directly with Yan Zhijie, hoping to recruit the former head of Tongyi Lab's speech team, but was ultimately declined. Yan Zhijie turned down Liu not because of the generous offer from Tencent AI Lab—in his heart, Yu Dong was a former colleague from Microsoft, and this bond outweighed everything. So, Yan Zhijie unreservedly joined Yu Dong's team. However, unforeseen circumstances arose. By the time Yan Zhijie started, Yu Dong's speech team had already begun collaborating with the Hunyuan team on a project to rival Doubao's speech capabilities—"Hunyuan-O." At that point, the Hunyuan team was under intense development pressure, and the speech + visual understanding team was already established, with the project underway. Personnel changes affected Yan Zhijie, who had just joined Tencent. Some say Yan himself was reassigned to Hunyuan, preventing him from joining forces with Yu Dong; others say a portion of Yan's team was transferred, leaving him with a small group of three to five people in AI Lab. However, the development of the "Hunyuan-O" project did not go smoothly. Due to a lack of speech data, the team struggled to make progress.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, the top international academic journal *Science* published a special report focusing on leading scholars in the global frontier of materials science. Professor Li Hao, Chairman of MatSource, was interviewed in the report, sharing his profound insights on the future development of materials science. A New Landscape and New Paradigm "What we need is a new landscape, a new paradigm." — Professor Li Hao, Chairman of MatSource. This core viewpoint proposed by Professor Li Hao in his interview with *Science* not only directly addresses the pain points of traditional materials science—"high cost, long cycles, reliance on trial and error and experience"—but also offers deep insight into the critical transformation period the industry is currently undergoing. He pointed out that with the rapid development of artificial intelligence and data-driven methods, future materials research and development must break through the limitations of "single material, single performance" and move comprehensively toward complex system modeling, cross-scale design, and intelligent discovery. This is not merely an iterative upgrade of research tools, but a fundamental reshaping of scientific thinking and underlying paradigms.
